own_full_chain_observation: Actual Mod constructor/CommonProxy attach native bus/channel/tickers; registry primer creates/registers Dodge and ChargeMaximum. Dodge constructor attaches HIGH LivingDamage, CommonProxy attaches limiter. Allocation/login/clone rebuild unsealed source effects, client packets update current player. Config default80/range1..500 is declaration, not installed value. Current perk-tree JSON/all equipment/converter producers not expanded.

Type side/UUID membership differs from resource balance. PerkEffectHelper rebuilds converted/extra modifiers and invokes type onApply; onRemove disables only when final modifier map has no same type. AttributeModifierPerk rejects sealed modifiers. Seal removes/sends before seal mutation can fail; shown path has no rollback. Comparison-key dedup is not a paid-hit receipt.

HIGH LivingDamage requires PlayerEntity/type membership. Addition, added/stack multipliers and perk-effect scaling produce chance/100; PostProcess HIGH clamp0..0.75 can be changed by later listeners. chance>=nextFloat then short-circuit drain(false); only true cancels. chance0 equality can admit RNG0 syntactically. No local positive/source/angle/Boss/server-only gate or denial feedback. No final Forge arbitration claim.

Private static current/max side->UUID->float owners independently default1000. Creative/spectator full/free; survival drain balance>=cost/result>=0 then clamp(result,0,max), no immediate packet/hit ID/receipt/refund. Capacity recalculation clamps current without publishing; last dodge-source removal is not a balance reset. Other shared charge consumers not counted.

PLAYER/END returns if current>=max, otherwise environment/attribute/postprocess regen then upper cap and sync. No shown lower/finite check for extension values. Actual ObserverLib forwards event player/side/phase. Charge handler has no server-only exit; constructor reads SERVER maps before sendToPlayer guards ServerPlayer type. Not a demonstrated cross-thread race or wrong packet.

Bounded fixed Java search finds below-cap regen as only ordinary new PktSyncCharge(player) producer, decoder is separate; resetChargeReveal only declaration. Full-cap capacity clamp alone has no reconciliation path; source sync may independently recalculate cap. No guaranteed stale UI asserted.

Charge packet queues two raw floats to current player with no null/finite/range/world/epoch/sequence/actor/reason/hit check. CLIENT receive writes values. Other source/activity handlers have null guard, so absence not universalized. Shared state receipt does not acknowledge actual dodge.

HUD CLIENT/END reveals20 for ratio<=.95 or revealer and fades15; Post ALL skips spectator/alpha<=0. First equipped item consumer previews cost, not Dodge. Strict percFilled>usage differs from drain>=exactCost. Rectangle submissions are not validated pixels/sound or Boss feedback.

Actual cache native callbacks remove/rebuild eligible perks and clear type/modifier maps on client disconnect/server stop. Private charge owner has no clear API and those callbacks do not touch maps. No world/session key or NBT balance persistence shown. Same-process UUID reuse can retain balance; capacity onRemove can clamp it; restart resets statics. Bounded source fact, no reflection/integration/runtime exploit claim.

One whole attribute-qualified paid-denial/resource reconciliation/teardown policy only. Six nearest full semantic decisions plus complete substantive Vortex/Sidestep judgments and full saved migration owner compared. Old migration boundary explicitly excludes numeric modifier behavior. Helpers, ranges, packets, formula, missing cleanup and source variants add0.
